title: Use of Blinded Tapering for Hypnotic Discontinuation
brief_summary: The study will employ a randomized longitudinal clinical trial design to evaluate the relative efficacy of a blinded hypnotic tapering protocol when used in combination with therapist delivered Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBTI) for enhancing hypnotic discontinuation rates. A blinded SMT+CBTI intervention will be compared to open-label SMT+CBTI.
condition: Hypnotic Dependence Among Those With Insomnia
